narration: Your cousin's coaching fee came up at dinner in month {fork_month}, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice}. In month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart, the ghost's month a little fuller than yours. The ghost's money reached its lowest point in month {ghost_lowest_month}. When the layoff arrived in month {layoff_month}, the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
